```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Technologies ought to be contextually appropriate, considering use value relative to social necessity, energy demand and pollution for production relative to maintenance, and durability relative to recyclability.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":["[1]"]},{"claim_text":"Support for a philosophy of convivial technology, which facilitates interpersonal connection, can be easily replicated by different people under different conditions, and can be managed democratically rather than technocratically.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":["[2]"]},{"claim_text":"Do not oppose but embrace certain high technologies essential for modern material comforts and a high quality of life, on the condition their supply chains are rendered as socially and environmentally just as possible.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":["[3]"]},{"claim_text":"Examples of technologies embraced include the Internet, laptops, mobile phones, high-speed rail, GPS systems and satellites, refrigeration, air conditioning and heat pumps, solar panels, wind turbines, and rechargeable batteries, provided their supply chains are socially and environmentally just.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":["[3]"]},{"claim_text":"Recognize the critical role of technology in empowering the Global South to meet their needs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":["[4]"]},{"claim_text":"Call for extensive technology transfers and releasing of intellectual property to empower the Global South.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":["[4]"]},{"claim_text":"The Left must help birth a new, post-carbon cultural hegemony as soon as possible to rehabilitate, regenerate and preserve the conditions for life on Earth, given the immediate task of building a multiracial, mass, working class movement to transform capitalism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":["[5]"]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
